<div class="card-body">
'''Hem Dazon''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヘム・デイゾン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の支配フェイズに、手札かフォース・デッキからカードを1枚、ヘムの下に伏せて置くことができる。これは“塩の摂取量”を表わす。ヘムがロストした時には、その下にあるカードもロストする。＊戦闘力＝1＋下に置かれたカードの枚数。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Hem-Dazon-PSA-89673865.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">コーナから来た男性の偵察兵。多くのアルコーナ同様、ヘムもまた塩の誘惑に負け、中毒症状に陥って瞳が金色になってしまった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hem Dazon.

'''Card text:'''
During your control phase, you may place one card from hand or Force Deck face down under Hem. This represents salt consumption. When Hem is lost, the cards under him are also lost. Power equals 1 plus the number of cards placed underneath.

'''Lore:'''
A male scout from Cona. Like many Arcona, Hem succumbed to salt, became addicted, and his pupils turned gold.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title transliterates Dazon as デイゾン.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hem Dazon]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
